description: Project-scoped MCP server configuration for ContextForge. These servers provide repository-specific tools for the AI coding agent. Global tools (filesystem, browser, shell) are excluded — they are configured at the global level.

contextforge-gcs-inspector.description: Local GCS blob inspector for the contextforge-outputs bucket. Allows the AI agent to browse, read, and verify agent output blobs by session_id without needing to write code to do so.

list_session_blobs.description: List all GCS blobs for a given session_id. Returns blob names, sizes, and last-modified timestamps.

session_id.description: UUID v4 session ID. Blobs are under gs://{bucket}/{session_id}/

read_blob_json.description: Read and return the JSON content of a specific GCS blob. Use to inspect agent output, merged BRD, or score matrix.

blob_name.description: Blob filename within the session prefix. E.g., 'agent_vc.json', 'merged_brd.json', 'score_matrix.json'

delete_session_blobs.description: Delete all blobs for a given session_id. Use to clean up test sessions after smoke tests.

session_id.description: UUID v4 session ID to clean up

contextforge-bq-inspector.description: BigQuery log inspector for ContextForge analytics tables. Allows the AI agent to query context harvest logs, evaluator scores, and BRD run metadata without leaving the IDE.

get_brd_run.description: Retrieve a BRD run record from the brd_runs table by session_id.

list_recent_runs.description: List the most recent BRD runs, ordered by created_at descending.

limit.description: Maximum number of runs to return. Default: 10. Max: 50.

status_filter.description: Optional: filter by status. One of: intake, harvesting, swarm_running, evaluating, merging, complete, failed.

get_evaluator_scores.description: Retrieve all evaluator scores for a given session_id. Returns the full score matrix as stored in BigQuery.

get_harvest_logs.description: Retrieve context harvest logs for a session. Shows which APIs were called, their response codes, and latencies.

query_run_stats.description: Aggregate statistics across all BRD runs. Returns average investor readiness score, most common regions, and failure rates.

since_hours.description: Look back this many hours. Default: 24.

contextforge-fastapi-dev.description: Local FastAPI development server manager. Allows the AI agent to start, stop, and restart the development backend without switching to a terminal. Also provides route listing for API contract verification.

start_backend.description: Start the FastAPI development server on the specified port with --reload.

stop_backend.description: Stop the running FastAPI development server.

restart_backend.description: Restart the FastAPI development server (stop + start).

list_routes.description: List all registered FastAPI routes with their HTTP methods, paths, and expected request/response models.

health_check.description: Call the /health endpoint of the running backend and return the JSON response.

contextforge-gemini-tester.description: Gemini API test harness. Allows the AI agent to test individual agent prompts with a sample business idea and inspect the raw response, token count, and JSON parse status — without going through the full pipeline.

test_agent_prompt.description: Fire a single Gemini Flash call with a named agent's system prompt and a sample business idea. Returns the raw response text, token count, and whether the response parses as valid BRD JSON.

agent_name.description: One of: vc, lean, cto, ux, regulator, adversarial

business_idea.description: Sample business idea text to test the agent against.
business_idea.default: An app to help small restaurants in India manage inventory and reduce food waste using AI predictions.

test_all_agents.description: Fire all 6 agent prompts in parallel against the same business idea. Returns a side-by-side comparison of outputs, token counts, and divergence indicators.

business_idea.default: An app to help small restaurants in India manage inventory and reduce food waste using AI predictions.

estimate_token_cost.description: Estimate the total token consumption for a full BRD run (6 Flash + 2 Pro calls) based on a sample intake package. Returns token counts and estimated daily capacity.

intake_text_length_chars.description: Estimated character length of the intake summary + context package.
